plan.title: Liver treated vs control DE with strandedness-aware QC
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a raw gene-level count matrix (12000 genes x 6 samples: 3 treated, 3 control liver samples) from STAR/featureCounts, with metadata carrying condition labels, and no recorded library strandedness. Because the strand setting used at counting is unknown and the analysis has only the count matrix (no FASTQ/BAM), we cannot re-run RSeQC infer_experiment on aligned reads as the ideal fix requires; instead we (1) run a count-matrix-level strandedness sanity check using antisense-overlapping gene pairs and known monoallelic/imprinted or strictly single-strand-expressed marker genes from the GENCODE annotation to flag gross strand-assignment artifacts (a proxy check, explicitly weaker than infer_experiment on BAMs), and (2) carry the caveat through every downstream step and the final report rather than silently trusting the counts. The core analysis is a standard DESeq2 workflow: sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library size), minimal low-count pre-filter, median-of-ratios normalization internal to DESeq2, an explicit ~condition design with control as the reference level, a Wald test for treated_vs_control, apeglm shrinkage of the reported fold change, BH-adjusted significance at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, and a p-value histogram diagnostic. Given only 3 replicates per group the test is underpowered for small effects; this is stated explicitly rather than compensated by loosening thresholds. A second DE method (edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test) runs on the same design as a robustness cross-check per the small-n guidance, and the intersection of the two gene sets is reported as the high-confidence list. Enrichment runs as fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (locally staged) and Reactome (locally staged) gene sets, with gene symbols mapped to Entrez via org.Hs.eg.db and the unmapped share reported. The final report consolidates QC, DE (both methods and their overlap), enrichment, all reproducibility metadata (package versions, seed, gene set collection versions), and states the strandedness and power caveats up front.
